motivation: Confirm63 off-then-one had negative AI completion difference. Fresh channel seeds and reversed one-then-off execution order test whether the sign is robust to order; no threshold retuning.
research_question: Does submitting one bounded AI RPC while NeuralRx remains unobserved retain the same radio/safety outcome and how does total AI throughput change under fresh seeds and reverse order?
frozen_gates: Same trace, zero deadline/path/AI/credit violation; one-mode >=100 pre-radio AI RPCs completed before first fallback guard; radio loss <=2/400. Total AI throughput sign and latency difference are reported without a pass threshold to avoid redefining the earlier negative result.
interpretation_limits: Two 200-release orders are a diagnostic for order confounding, not a strong statistical proof of causal throughput difference or production guarantee. Host outstanding overlap, no GPU kernel overlap proof or WCET.
